doc.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Being hard on herself and never listening back
summary: She always thinks she could do better and still can't bear to hear her recordings.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Well, I don‟t think so but… Brown, C.: Oh.
As long as you were happy with it. Brown, C.: Very.
I always think I can do better, but maybe that‟s part of what it‟s about. You never know it all. You gotta keep doing it, you know. Brown, C.: Yeah.
And you improve or learn new things all the time. I‟m a little hard on myself. I‟m a little bit better now than I used to be. Brown, C.: She‟s better.
Oh. I still don‟t listen to myself. Nah, [inaudible]. Brown, C.: She can‟t bear to listen to anything that she‟s on.
